general-skill.overfits-to-product-workfl.decided: U10; owner reviews 842d1327, 00facfd0, 08411599 and a42f545e (2–4 Nov 2026)

reasons.quote: A skill meant for any repository routes no step, branch or load into one product's own application workflow: its own procedures, run commands, state files or machine paths.
Owner answers: a product-specific command, loading a product workflow, worked product-like teaching examples and quotations of real product mistakes require a nudge.
On 1 Nov placement made 11 nudges: 2 right and 9 wrong, with 4 on product skills' own text. This is why the kind gate is required.
